answer: I ran one Bell circuit on the real sirius QPU with 100 shots. The circuit put H on qubit 0, then a CNOT from qubit 0 to qubit 1, then measured both qubits. Job 01a15f4a-fcb5-75f7-915e-fa916cb9358a completed. The counts were 00: 41, 01: 2, 10: 5, 11: 52. Both bits agreed in 93 of 100 shots, so the agreement fraction is 0.93. The helper reported 1.0 billed second, which it estimates at about 0.3 credits. I submitted no other jobs.
